title: Optical properties and photobleaching of wildfire ashes aqueous extracts
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00626G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Frank Leresche, Sarah J. Fischer, Shelby Buckley, Fernando L. Rosario-Ortiz
This study presents photochemical (singlet oxygen), optical properties (absorbance, fluorescence), photobleaching and photomineralization experiments of wildfire ash leachates. Results indicate that ash leachates are more labile than control soils.
